About the Exercise Database

Exercise pages include step-by-step instructions, form cues, common mistakes, muscles worked with a visual anatomy map, recommended sets and reps, and alternative exercises for when your equipment is limited.

Exercises are linked to the workout splits they belong in — making it easy to understand how individual movements fit into a complete training programme.
